tiles.title: Proxy
tiles.description: Enable or disable the Windows proxy

stateCommand.arguments: -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "if ((Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -Name ProxyEnable -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProxyEnable -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

tiles.title: Theme
tiles.description: Switch between the Windows light and dark themes

stateCommand.arguments: -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "if ((Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize' -Name AppsUseLightTheme -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).AppsUseLightTheme -ne 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

enableCommand.arguments: -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$source = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Themes\TranscodedWallpaper'; $directory = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'timActionCenter\Themes'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $directory | Out-Null; $target = Join-Path $directory 'TranscodedWallpaper'; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $target -Force; & '{AppDirectory}\ThemeSwitcher.exe' 'aero.theme'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; & '{AppDirectory}\RefreshWallpaper.exe' $target"

disableCommand.arguments: -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$source = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Themes\TranscodedWallpaper'; $directory = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'timActionCenter\Themes'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $directory | Out-Null; $target = Join-Path $directory 'TranscodedWallpaper'; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $target -Force; & '{AppDirectory}\ThemeSwitcher.exe' 'dark.theme'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; & '{AppDirectory}\RefreshWallpaper.exe' $target"
